formula: Sleeper Score 0-100 = 15 deep value (drawdown from ATH, years since ATH) + 20 fundamentals (DefiLlama fees 30d vs prior 30d, mcap/annualized fees) + 15 narrative (sector 30d median move, laggard gap) + 15 volatility compression then expansion + 15 relative strength vs BTC turning up + 10 accumulation proxy (volume rising in a tight range) + 5 developer commits (CoinGecko) + 5 derivatives (Hyperliquid funding not crowded, OI present). A>=70, B>=58, C>=46, D>=34. Universe: CoinGecko top 1000, >=50% below an ATH set >=9 months ago, no stables/wrapped.
limits: Holder counts and exchange flows are not free for most chains, so accumulation is a price/volume proxy.
X/social mention counts are not free; narrative momentum uses sector price moves.

cases.note: Window starts 180 days into the 365-day history (signals need 120-180 days of lookback), so a breakout earlier than that cannot be flagged.

accumulation.definition: >=3 of: |30d change| <15%, 60-day range <50%, 20d vol <0.8x 120d vol, 30d volume >1.2x prior 90d. Outcome: max price within next 30 days >= +30%. Sampled every 5 days on 49 tokens (heavily overlapping, survivorship-biased: today's top-1000).
accumulation.verdict: NO EDGE: does not beat the base rate in this sample; treat as descriptive only

lookalike_backtest.definition: Breakout = price >= 2x 60-day low and a new 90-day high. Fingerprint = mean of features 30-90 days before breakout. Similarity = exp(-standardized RMS distance). Leave-one-token-out.
lookalike_backtest.verdict: NO EDGE: does not beat the base rate in this sample; treat as descriptive only
